about.bio: I'm a second-year B.Tech student at IIT Guwahati exploring web development through hands-on projects. I enjoy creating interactive applications that solve real problems, from algorithm visualizers to circuit analyzers. Currently learning modern web technologies while balancing academics and contributing to institute web projects.

education.degree: B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering

projects.title: Circuit Analyser
projects.description: Developed a web application for analyzing electrical circuits with instant voltage and current calculations using React frontend, Node.js backend, and Python computational engine. Implemented graph-based algorithms and equation solvers integrated with the backend API, returning formatted mathematical expressions and dynamically generated circuit plots.

projects.title: Algo Visualiser
projects.description: The Sorting Algorithm Visualizer is an educational web application designed to help students, educators, and developers understand how different sorting algorithms work. Watch algorithms sort data step-by-step with smooth animations, adjustable speed controls, and interactive features.

projects.title: Portfolio
projects.description: A personal portfolio website for Pittala Sree Sai Pavan, a Frontend Web Developer and B.Tech ECE student at IIT Guwahati. Built with HTML5, CSS3, featuring a modern dark theme, responsive design, and smooth scroll navigation. Showcases skills, projects, education, and experience with an elegant minimal UI.

projects.title: HabitFlow
projects.description: Being a Vibecoding enthusiast, designed a modern web app that helps users build consistent routines through gamification. Implemented a GitHub-style activity heatmap to track daily progress and streaks. Focused on intuitive design and responsive layouts for a seamless user experience across devices.

projects.title: RecipeFinder
projects.description: Recipe Finder is a sleek, responsive web application that helps you discover delicious recipes from around the world. Powered by TheMealDB API, it offers a seamless experience to browse, search, and explore recipes with detailed ingredients and cooking instructions.

projects.title: MovieWebsite
projects.description: A fully responsive, Netflix-inspired movie discovery platform built entirely with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. This project demonstrates modern frontend development skills without relying on any external frameworks.

projects.title: P.A.R.K.E.R
projects.description:
Architected a 4-layer persistent memory system (profile, facts, projects, episodic) backed by PostgreSQL + pgvec
tor, with importance-tiered retrieval and automatic archival of stale entries; memory stored as structured JSON
extracted by an LLM — raw transcripts never persisted.– Built a 5-level temporal rollup pipeline (chat → day → week → month → year) on ISO calendar boundaries,
running on background threads with per-namespace write locks, orchestrated by a LangGraph state machine with
a trigger gate that skips retrieval on casual messages to keep latency near zero.
